CustomField.description: This field is system generated and calculated the difference between the values in the fields, Amount & ATG RFR (Amount - ATG RFR = Non ATG RFR)
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Captures the dollar amount of services that will be staffed and delivered by Non-ATG Resources. (e.g. AIM, CTS Global Salesforce Practice, SAP, Oracle)
CustomField.label: Non-ATG RFR
